correctness.rationale: For the specified rank-one projections, Pauli channel eigenvectors diagonalize exactly with eigenvalues 3/4 and 1/4+1/(2 sqrt 2). The squared-step insertion decomposes into 5/16 and 3/16 of those modes, producing positive 25/32 and 9/32 lag coefficients. Stationary fourth moment 17/4 yields diagonal variance 43/16; finite geometric convolution gives the full Q_n variance and its limit. Paired signed jump cancellation and Bloch-disk linear optimization establish arbitrary-state finite-time transport bounds. The actual embedded standalone checker independently enumerates labelled paths n=1..6 and validates 29 lags and 50 extremal states; finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The original example has a centered diffusion-scale spatial CLT but noncommuting measurement-induced memory. The result exhibits two exact intrinsic output memory modes and almost 3.854 times more asymptotic quadratic-variation variance than an iid process with exactly the same marginal jump law. This matters for uncertainty and finite-trajectory energy statistics; the complete state-preparation envelope is motivated by the same internal modes, not an unmotivated numerical slice.
